info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Fitness Membership API empowers businesses to streamline their membership management by allowing consumers to easily cancel fitness memberships. This endpoint facilitates user-initiated cancellation requests, ensuring that members can quickly disengage without friction. Typical use cases involve fitness centers and health clubs managing membership transitions while maintaining customer satisfaction. Utilizing this API, developers can efficiently integrate cancellation functionalities into their applications, enhancing the overall user experience.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows users to cancel their active membership. Upon successful cancellation, the membership status will be updated to reflect the change. Ensure that you handle any potential errors accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to specify the necessary parameters to cancel a membership. Ensure that you provide all required fields to successfully process the cancellation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: Request body for cancelling a membership operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing more information about the result of the cancellation.

audit.description: Audit information regarding the cancellation operation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for successful cancellation of a membership operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A value of 0 represents a processing time that is negligible.
